subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KHEB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/742e5267ce934089aff8fde9fbae5b8a08551a2d4b7e1829d427c8747fbdc9f3.png] 

Option 2) AXUR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c951e193260962edf20623c76f010aacc20974765a8648cd6ebe82c160abbaa.png] 

Option 3) GDAX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56c7c8d515cd8fe75d7b6c401b23f5fb111e435e3929f9aa4176db1d5665cbbb.png] 

Option 4) OKJH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a434fac106a4dc6bd813332c3004ebeb4848da79aff185a13aca040ee65d18e.png]

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
